name: Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps Original (Flat Pretzels)
whyItWorks: Flat, thin, and lightly toasted without the dense interior dough of thick pretzels. They break down effortlessly in the mouth with very little chewing effort and deliver light sodium for electrolyte support.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy straight from the bag or dip into smooth cream cheese, mild hummus (if tolerated), or creamy peanut butter.
watchOuts: Avoid garlic-parmesan or spicy buffalo varieties during sensitive digestive periods.
